name: masons-yard
description: Mason's Yard (masons_yard, masons_yard_2), rebuilt blind for ROADMAP 49 (tools/blueprints/REBUILD.md). MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. LEVEL=1|2 picks the level; 'build' writes both candidates.

scripts.build: npm run build:1 && npm run build:2
scripts.build:1: rm -rf out && LEVEL=1 node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py masons_yard masons_yard --candidate
scripts.build:2: rm -rf out && LEVEL=2 node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py masons_yard masons_yard_2 --candidate
